import numpy as np, json, os, re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def maximal_rects(g,col):
    g=np.array(g); h,w=g.shape; seen=np.zeros((h,w),bool); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if seen[r,c] or g[r][c]!=col: continue
            R=c
            while R+1<w and g[r][R+1]==col: R+=1
            D=r
            while D+1<h and all(g[D+1][cc]==col for cc in range(c,R+1)): D+=1
            L=c
            while L-1>=0 and g[D][L-1]==col: L-=1
            seen[r:D+1,L:R+1]=True
            out.append((D-r+1,R-c+1,L,D))
    return out

    g=np.array(G[name]); go=np.array(G[name.replace('input','output')])
    ch=(g!=go)
    print('==',name)
    changed_areas=set()
    for reg in regions(ch):
        rs_=[r for r,c in reg]; cs_=[c for r,c in reg]
        col=int(g[reg[0][0],reg[0][1]])
        h_=max(rs_)-min(rs_)+1; w_=max(cs_)-min(cs_)+1
        changed_areas.add(h_*w_)
    for col in sorted(set(np.unique(g)[1:])):
        for d,wd,L,D in maximal_rects(g,col):
            a=d*wd
            isch = any(all(ch[i][j] for i in range(L,L+d) for j in range(c0,c0+wd)) for c0 in [L])
            inside=all(ch[i][j] for i in range(L,L+d) for j in range(L,L+wd))
            print(f' col {col} size {a} at ({L},{D}) w{wd}d{d} changed={inside}')

import numpy as np
def maxrect_col(g,col):
    # returns (area, h, w, r0, c0) of the LARGEST solid rectangle of color col
    g=np.array(g); h,w=g.shape; best=None; H=[0]*w
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w): H[c]=H[c]+1 if g[r][c]==col else 0
        st=[]; prev=-1
        for i in range(len(H)+1):
            cur=H[i] if i<len(H) else 0
            while st and st[-1][1]>=cur:
                top,th=st.pop(); k=i-prev-1
                a=top*k
                lo = st[-1][0] if st else -1
                cand=(a,th,k,lo,st[-1][0]) if False else (a,th,k,lo,st[-1][0],i-th+1 if False else th+k)
                cand=(a,th,k,lo,st[-1][0],r-top)
                if best is None or a>best[0]: best=cand
                break
